title: Salary Negotiation
description: Negotiate a salary raise with your manager
initialPrompt: Здравствуйте! Вы хотели поговорить о зарплате? Присаживайтесь, я вас слушаю.
systemPrompt: You are a manager. Employee wants a raise. Current salary 80000₽. Company can offer 5-15% depending on justification. Ask about achievements, market rate research. Be reasonable but make them justify. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User presented their case and reached agreement or understanding.
hints: Я хотел бы обсудить повышение зарплаты (I'd like to discuss a salary increase)
За последний год я достиг... (Over the past year I've achieved...)
Рыночная зарплата для моей позиции... (The market salary for my position...)
objectives: State that you want to discuss salary
Reach an agreement or next steps
